title: Cross-Database Identity Resolution Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Methods to match equivalent people, places, concepts, and records across sources. The Cross-Database Identity Resolution Database solves the 'same thing, different name' problem: 'J. Higgins' in one database and 'Justin Higgins' in another may be the same person — or not. Records include matching algorithms (exact, fuzzy, phonetic, embedding-based), blocking strategies that make large-scale matching affordable, confidence scoring, and human-review queues for the uncertain middle. Getting identity wrong merges strangers or splits one person in two, so every match carries its evidence and confidence.

title: Cross-Database Identity Resolution Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Matching pipeline: normalize (lowercase, strip punctuation, expand abbreviations) -> block (partition by key like surname-initial + birth-year so O(n^2) becomes O(sum of block sizes)) -> compare (similarity per field) -> score -> decide. Similarities: Jaro-Winkler for names, Levenshtein for strings, Soundex/Metaphone for phonetics, cosine of embeddings for semantics. Scoring: weighted sum or logistic regression over matcher outputs, calibrated on labeled pairs: P(match | features). Decision: auto-merge above high threshold, auto-reject below low, human review between. Metrics: precision = correct merges / total merges; recall = correct merges / true duplicates; tune thresholds on labeled data, never on vibes.

demo.code: function jw(a,b){a=a.toLowerCase();b=b.toLowerCase();if(a===b)return 1;let m=0;const n=Math.min(a.length,b.length);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)if(a[i]===b[i])m++;return m/Math.max(a.length,b.length);}const pairs=[['Jon Smith','John Smith'],['Jon Smith','Maria Garcia']];const scored=pairs.map(([x,y])=>({x,y,s:+jw(x,y).toFixed(2)}));J({scored});assert(scored[0].s>scored[1].s,'match');

title: Cross-Database Identity Resolution Database — Verification: tests and limitations
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Tests: labeled-pair test (precision/recall measured, reported honestly); normalization test (known variants normalize identically); blocking test (true duplicates land in the same block); audit test (every merge has an evidence trail); no-silent-merge test. Limitations: thresholds are dataset-specific; embedding matchers need representative training data; human review is the backstop, not an optional extra. Matchers carry versioned configs and test-set scores.

demo.title: Execution: pipeline stage hashing and replay
demo.code: const crypto=require('crypto');function h(s){return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex').slice(0,8);}const stages=['import','clean','validate','export'];const data='raw-data-v1';let cur=data;const hashes=stages.map(s=>{cur=s+':'+cur;return s+'='+h(cur);});const replay=(()=>{let c=data;return stages.map(s=>{c=s+':'+c;return s+'='+h(c);});})();J({hashes:hashes.length,replayMatch:JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay)});assert(JSON.stringify(hashes)===JSON.stringify(replay),'replay');
